name: ICRDenominatorSourceCS
title: ICR Denominator Source
description: The method/source behind a target-population estimate. Every estimate carries its source and date — the denominator is the dominant source of error in campaign analytics (working doc §4.2).

concept.definition: Local enumeration from microplanning or household registration.
Derived from routine HMIS targets or registers.

An official government figure whose underlying method is unspecified — the low-precision escape that lets early or administrative estimates declare a source (v0.1: denominator-source is mandatory on every estimate).
Source not recorded — for historical/back-loaded datasets where provenance cannot be reconstructed.
Other source — record detail in text.
